# LiveKit UniFFI license supplement

The pinned 0.0.5 archive omitted a license file. LiveKit subsequently added the
Apache-2.0 license to this upstream repository (now named livekit-ffi-xcframework).
We include that unmodified upstream license text with our packages.

- Upstream license: https://github.com/livekit/livekit-ffi-xcframework/blob/main/LICENSE
- License blob SHA: 261eeb9e9f8b2b4b0d119366dda99c6fd7d35c64
- Upstream fix: https://github.com/livekit/livekit-ffi-xcframework/issues/10
- SDK tracking issue: https://github.com/livekit/client-sdk-swift/issues/972
- Retrieved: 2026-11-13

No binary or generated binding was modified by this supplement. Reassess this
supplement when upgrading the SDK to a release that includes its own notices.
